name: classic-shards
_comment: Canonical SHARDS-mode Classic cycle for the trace harness and the Studio detach parity gate: SHARDS_DIG_CLICKS=2 exact-click digging. Toggle at 0; the dig leg settles PRE_DIG_SETTLE_MS then click 1 lands at 80-155; the capacity jumps to FULL at 200 (whole-box paint is binary with the screen-rect trick, so 'bar leaves EMPTY' and 'FULL' arrive together) inside the max(30,SHARDS_CLICK_CONFIRM_MS) proof window, so click 1 is CONFIRMED; the follow-up click rides the dig rhythm gap (190000/DIG_SPEED+25 = 1925ms at default speed); the fill wait then reads FULL instantly; go_water reaches the Pan cue at 2250 inside the first budget; do_shake drains to EMPTY at 2500 (inside SHAKE_BAIL_MS) with momentum W; the quit lands inside the post-shake settle, so the healthy golden carries zero safety events (the retry/nudge path is covered by classic-shards-miss). Lives in engine_goldens/classic_trace (NOT engine_scenarios/) so the characterization suite's auto-discovery is untouched; vendored to the Studio for its parity gate.
_screen_comment: The benign 1x1 rect flips the sim's capacity paint into whole-box mode (see classic-standard.json) so FULL is readable in full-frame grabs; with it the capacity read is effectively binary, so keyframes use 0/1 only.
